row.notes: Vtable slot 0xa0 of unnamed vtable 0x14579e440 (pointer 0x14579e4e0). Onboarding state byte self+0xe0: returns if 5. Reads Game.F1World.SkipOnboarding via Ne_Get_SettingBool on [self+0x70]+0x18, default 0; if set and state is not 2/3, takes O=[self+0x78]: if [O+0x68]+0x39 == 0 -> state 6; else if O+0x128|O+0x12c already has bit 0x100 -> state 3; otherwise sets bit 0x100 in O+0x128, restarts the timer pair O+0x100/+0x108 from the clock 0x145d3c778 + 0x1461089f8, and sets state 2 (or 3 when no timer was running). So the setting marks onboarding as done and advances the state machine.
